images.filename: F3H-2 Demon of VF-121 parked c1956.jpg
images.caption: A U.S. Navy McDonnell F3H-2N Demon (BuNo 133573) of Fighter Squadron VF-121 "Peacemakers". In March 1956, VF-14 received the first operational F3H-2N fighters. Eventually replaced by the F4H/F-4 Phantom, the F3H/F-3 served until 1964. The F3H-2N 133573 was later modified as a test bed for the AN/APQ-50 radar for the F4H-1 Phantom II
